::: {#exm-doubling-sequence}
#### The double-minus-one sequence, defined recursively

The sequence of @exr-doubling-terms has a recursive definition (@def-recursive-definition) with $n_0 = 0$.
Its base case is

$$
a_0 = 2,
$$

and its recursive rule is

$$
a_n = 2 a_{n-1} - 1
\quad\text{for every integer } n \ge 1.
$$

The recursive rule gives $a_n$ from the single value $a_{n-1}$ just before it,
so this is a recursively defined sequence (@def-recursive-sequence) with $m = 1$.

:::
